def transform(grid):
    # The four 4x4 panels are layers; later colors have priority except 8 over 5.
    colors = [8, 5, 9, 4]
    panels = [[row[i:i+4] for row in grid] for i in (0, 5, 10, 15)]
    priority = [5, 8, 4, 9]
    return [[next((c for c in reversed(priority) if any(p[y][x] == c for p in panels)), 0) for x in range(4)] for y in range(4)]
